requirements.statement: Regional Knowledge Base is intended for routine mass ingestion of books, not isolated successful demos. The system is mass-ingestion-ready only when production-like capacity, retrieval quality, latency, import-quality and operational-reliability gates all pass.
acceptance: The minimum engineering scale benchmark covers at least 100 book-equivalent sources and 100,000 active chunks, or a larger real corpus when available; this is a readiness benchmark, not a product limit.
Routine imports are resumable and idempotent, use bounded queues/backpressure, do not require keeping a ChatGPT turn open, and one failed/superseded revision cannot block unrelated books.
A book is not considered accepted merely because text or vectors were written; its active revision must pass the required import and retrieval acceptance.

requirements.statement: Mass ingestion must remain within measured Supabase capacity with explicit headroom; Supabase stores the vector/search plane and minimal scope/identity metadata rather than the full corpus.
acceptance: Full source text, scans/page images and detailed corpus geometry remain outside Supabase; Supabase usage includes vectors, vector indexes, minimal scope/identity anchors, Postgres indexes, TOAST and system/baseline overhead.
At the production-like scale benchmark, steady-state quantified database usage is at most 80% of the current applicable Supabase database quota and the largest-source reimport peak is at most 90%.
Capacity is established from measured database usage/growth, not row-count or raw-vector arithmetic alone.
Corpus completeness, evidence provenance and retrieval quality are not silently reduced merely to fit quota; if the gate fails, storage/index representation is optimized and remeasured.

requirements.statement: Dense vector retrieval must independently provide high-quality evidence discovery; lexical/FTS retrieval is a bounded complementary signal and must not mask weak vector search.
acceptance: The held-out source-grounded retrieval gate contains at least 30 distinct fact families and reports known-evidence Hit@5, Hit@10 and language slices without using lexical retrieval to prefilter dense candidates.
BGE-only known-evidence Hit@5 is at least 85% and Hit@10 at least 90% on the accepted held-out benchmark.
Every critical language slice that is part of the product, including Russian queries over German sources while German books are in scope, reaches at least 85% known-evidence Hit@10.
Release acceptance always reports BGE-only, E5-only, lexical-only and configured-fusion ablations separately; one branch cannot hide another branch's degradation.
Retrieval metrics use source-grounded evidence and held-out fact families and are not mislabeled as generated-answer accuracy.

requirements.statement: Knowledge search must have predictable low latency suitable for repeated agent tool calls, with bounded degradation rather than hidden long waits.
acceptance: On a production-like corpus and representative concurrency, warm backend ranked-candidate retrieval has p95 <= 1000 ms.
Public MCP search has p95 <= 1500 ms and a hard interaction deadline of 2000 ms for the evidence-search path.
No normal retrieval branch introduces an implicit multi-second or 10-second wait; unavailable slow branches either complete inside the same budget or return an explicit degraded state.
Latency acceptance reports percentiles, not only averages or best-case single queries.

requirements.statement: Each imported book must preserve source fidelity and be chunked for retrieval rather than for page layout or transport convenience.
acceptance: Scanner/service material that is not part of the book is excluded while printed book material and document->page->region provenance are preserved.
Retrieval chunks are coherent semantic passages around the measured approximately 256-token operating target; page boundaries are provenance and are not default embedding boundaries.
The exact final embedding input is counted with both deployed tokenizers; exceeding either 512-token hard limit blocks acceptance rather than silently truncating.

Before a newly imported or reprocessed book is considered accepted, source-grounded natural-query retrieval checks run against that exact active revision, including paraphrased queries and cross-language queries when relevant.

requirements.statement: Changes that can alter search quality, scale or latency must rerun the relevant mass-ingestion gates before production rollout.
acceptance: Changes to chunking, embedding model/space, vector indexes/search, fusion, lexical query formulation, authorization scope or storage placement rerun the applicable capacity, dense-quality and latency acceptance.
A green unit test suite or vector-readiness count alone is never sufficient evidence of mass-ingestion readiness.
Acceptance results identify the exact corpus/revision/model/search configuration so improvements cannot be inferred from incomparable benchmarks.

requirements.statement: These mass-ingestion, capacity, retrieval-quality and latency requirements are protected product requirements and must not be silently weakened or reinterpreted by implementation work.
acceptance: DevCoveer exposes this manifest automatically to implementation and review tasks.
If an implementation conflicts with a critical requirement, the conflict is surfaced instead of normalized into a weaker target.
Intentional requirement changes use requirements_update with an explicit owner authorization reference.

requirements.statement: Experts use the existing Regional Knowledge Base MCP resource directly from any compatible AI client or through Slack with dot as a replaceable executor. Both paths resolve the same canonical person and enforce current capabilities and resource ACL server-side; no separate expert MCP service, endpoint, corpus or identity registry is required.
acceptance: Personal resource-bound OAuth identifies the actual expert, never an owner invite or a client-supplied actor. Supported clients are verified individually; naming ChatGPT or Grok is not a compatibility result.

Slack resolves the verified provider account to the same existing RKB person UUID. A dedicated executor service uses the same MCP endpoint and a durable request/route/generation-bound authority; it never inherits dot's or the owner's unrelated credentials.

Effective permissions are the intersection of the person's current capabilities, source/case ACL and delivery audience; service execution is additionally limited by its service grant and request fence. Import and participant administration remain owner-only and unavailable through delegated expert requests.
Concurrent actors, cross-route access, lease/link/grant revocation, delayed results and direct calls to forbidden tools are checked on the server, regardless of catalog visibility.

Acceptance demonstrates direct personal research and Slack-delegated research on the same authorized case/revision, including a real non-owner, denial and revocation; documentation and green component tests alone do not establish live support.

requirements.statement: Regional Knowledge Base uses one durable user-request lifecycle across clients, preserving per-dialog context and order, equal-person fairness, measured resource admission and honest arithmetic ETA. Ordinary load queues accepted questions rather than discarding them; imports retain capacity for at least one supported search.
acceptance: Slack and supported direct/Mira clients use the existing request authority and MCP resource. Verified canonical people share fairness across clients; client-supplied actors or dialog IDs cannot bypass access checks.

Accepted requests survive restart and retain a final result/delivery outcome in the original dialog. Later dialog turns use completed prior context and cannot overtake an undelivered or uncertain predecessor; other dialogs continue.

Fair selection and measured stage permits apply atomically to every claim/resume/wake path, including an explicit request ID. Local resources, E5, external Kaggle BGE and vector dependencies are distinguished; capacity is calibrated and adapts to measured resource increases/decreases.

Forecasts use measured durations and the actual fair order, not an LLM or invented concurrency limits. ETA at most ten seconds causes no waiting message; longer ETA and material increases have durable coalesced notices only for the person's nearest request. Ready final answers take precedence.

Ordinary capacity waits do not consume outage retry budgets, expire accepted inputs or ask users to resend. Proven external unavailability produces one honest terminal response; unknown provider effects reconcile without blind resend and poison stages remain recoverable.

Import stages cooperate at existing safe durable boundaries and cannot consume the measured search reserve. Required BGE publication, source fidelity, prior active revision and Kaggle-only inference remain protected; no process kill or unsafe transaction pause.

The existing evidence-search deadline and latency/quality gates remain unchanged. Report queue wait and time to final answer separately; do not hide a long HTTP search behind the durable question queue.

Acceptance includes cross-client/dialog fairness, restart and stale-generation boundaries, notification thresholds, real resource calibration/resize and import+search concurrency, actual second-client result/ACK readback and held-out ETA error. A green unit suite or pending response alone does not prove product acceptance.
